title: Craftable Enchantement
description: Craft any enchanted book in a crafting table using XP bottles, a book, and a thematic ingredient — all 113 vanilla enchantments supported, with in-game config via ModMenu.
body:
# Craftable Enchantement

Tired of grinding for enchanted books? **Craftable Enchantement** lets you craft any of the **113 vanilla enchanted books** directly in a crafting table — no commands, no cheats, fully survival-friendly.

## How it works

Place **N XP bottles** (one per enchantment level), **1 Book**, and **1 thematic ingredient** in any crafting slot to get the enchanted book you want.

**Examples:**
- Fire Aspect II → `2× XP Bottle + Book + Flint & Steel`
- Protection IV → `4× XP Bottle + Book + Iron Chestplate`
- Mending → `1× XP Bottle + Book + Lily Pad`

## Features

- 📖 All 113 vanilla enchantments — every level
- ⚖️ Shapeless recipes, fully server-side compatible
- 🚫 Disable any default recipe via the in-game GUI
- ➕ Add custom recipes for modded enchantments
- ⚙️ Full **ModMenu** interface to manage everything in-game

## Compatibility

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 1.21.11 |
| Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.19.3 |
| Fabric API | required |
| ModMenu | optional |
